topology_edges.conditional_mechanism: If inflationary pressures are present, they can influence FOMC decisions regarding rate adjustments.
If the labor market is resilient, it can enable FOMC decisions regarding rate adjustments.
If the Federal Reserve reiterates its commitment to its inflation target, it can enable FOMC decisions regarding rate adjustments.
If indicators suggest ongoing inflationary pressures, they can enable FOMC decisions regarding rate adjustments.
An FOMC rate adjustment can trigger the signaling of a data-dependent approach to future policy.
If a data-dependent policy approach is signaled, it can lead to the anticipation of a policy pause.
If a policy pause is anticipated, it can cause a shift in market sentiment towards future rate stability.
If there is a shift in market sentiment towards future rate stability, it can lead to market recalibration and changes in short-term funding pressures.
An FOMC rate adjustment can counteract market recalibration and changes in short-term funding pressures.
Market recalibration and changes in short-term funding pressures can influence the target metric.
